input.title: The prevention of financial crime within an Islamic legal framework
input.abstract: The risks associated with financial crime threaten to undermine the stability of the international financial system. This paper explores the Islamic legal approach to the prevention of financial crime and how this can be integrated into international regulatory frameworks. © 2007 The Author. Journal compilation © Institute of Economic Affairs 2007.
